posts.author: monkeyintartan
posts.body:
Hi everyone,
It has been forever since I have used Rpg maker and I am looking at taking it back up for fun. I found this great plugin from Mog hunter that allows me to use images that animate on/off the screen when the current map has a name. I was wondering if someone can help me find away to use Plugin commands to changes the current image files and fonts.
The intention is that when a player goes into a different region aka from a forest to an open planes or desert etc, the pictures / font that are used in the generation of the map name are different so they can reflect the region the map is in. Aka the forest may have a tree come up with the name while the desert may have a little pyramid.
If anyone can help with this or point me in the right direction on how to learn how to edit/adjust the script myself I would be very great full.
I have attached the plugin file to the post.
Thankyou for all your help!!
